main_text.p: obedire nolint, poteft eos in ordinem redigere, & cogere, ut officium re-ctè, vigilanter, impigrè, fideliter faciant, atque à malis & scandalosis actionibus abstineant. Adeoque pro delicti ratione potest in eos animad-verrere civiliter, efficere seu mandare, ut suspendantur aut removeantur ab officio; speciatim si seditiosè concionentur, in[?] populum contra Magistratum concitare conentur, si in Magistratum contumeliosi sint, & in eum convitiis ac probris debacchentur (quod est unum ex gravissimis delictis, quorum in Scriptura falsi Doctores rei peraguntur 2. Pet. 2. 10. Jud. v. 8. veri autem Doctores ajunt hoc grave crimen esse & non feren-dum in Republicâ bene constitutâ: Sib-brandus cont. Grot. p. 1.) si errores aut hereses doceant; si denique alioquin flagitiosi sint. Hæc propositio etiam est totius Reformatæ Ecclesiæ.
Confess. Anglic. artic. 37. ait: Ma-gistratibus summis hanc prærogativam

page.notes: The word after "in" at the start of the line about the people ("ıı populum") is badly printed; read as "in" with [?]. "conentur" and "Pet. 2." are as far as legible. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The line ending "Ma-gistratibus summis hanc prærogativam" continues on the next page. The signature "C 4" is a gathering mark, not a catchword.
